purpose: Freeze the longer-horizon six-pair whole-architecture language analysis and stopping rule before any finalist config, checkpoint, or result exists.

shared_training.checkpoint_retention: one complete final model, optimizer, metadata, timing, and completion marker per run; validation history remains in the final metadata and run summary

statistical_contract.primary_rule: the upper one-sided paired 95% Student-t bound must be at or below 0.01 nats and every source-loss upper bound must be at or below 0.02 nats
statistical_contract.multiplicity: one frozen whole-architecture candidate is tested; source guardrails are an intersection gate rather than separate discovery claims
statistical_contract.replication_limit: six crossed seed/data-order pairs support the finalist language screen but do not substitute for scale transfer or independent capability evaluation

fixed_analytic_flops.method: piecewise-linear interpolation between enclosing frozen validation boundaries

fixed_steady_training_time.budget: minimum final steady_training_seconds across arms within each pair
fixed_steady_training_time.method: piecewise-linear interpolation in steady training seconds; startup, validation, checkpointing, and orchestration remain excluded

time_to_quality.target: lock from all six controls before any candidate result is created or inspected
time_to_quality.method: first piecewise-linear downward crossing in steady training seconds
time_to_quality.censoring: retain every pair where either arm does not reach the target; never form a complete-case confidence bound

control_only_target_lock.rule: maximum final validation loss across all six complete dense controls, rounded upward to six decimals
order: collect and qualify all six dense-control results
write and hash the target lock
only then create or inspect candidate result records
analyze exactly the twelve frozen cells
control_only_target_lock.reason: all controls must reach the target while candidate failures remain explicit right-censoring

stopping_rule.pair_abandonment: forbidden after seeing either arm's quality
allowed_interruptions: non-finite loss or gradient raised by the runtime
hardware, thermal, memory, or filesystem safety limit
stopping_rule.recovery: resume the same frozen cell from its latest valid checkpoint; otherwise retain the failed attempt and preregister any rerun
stopping_rule.analysis_on_incomplete_sample: integrity report only; no paired bound or finalist language decision

decision_authority.may: pass or fail the longer-horizon whole-architecture language screen and supply one part of architecture-promotion evidence
may_not: attribute benefit to KDA, NoPE, GQA, or the 3:1 ratio
promote the architecture without every policy capability and systems gate
establish N1, N2, or any Speck novelty
make serving, long-context, or release claims from language loss

execution.reason: finalist configs, storage, output absence, runtime, analysis implementation, and release-evaluation dependencies require separate qualification
